Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (1) 📘 Rule violations (0) 📜 Skill insights (0)
1. Fallback keys are ignored 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness
>
>Description >
> >
>get_signing_serializer no longer supplies SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS, so cookies signed by retained
>old keys fail verification and open_session silently replaces them with empty sessions.
>Deployments rotating SECRET_KEY will therefore log users out despite explicitly configuring
>fallback keys.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[src/flask/sessions.py[L321-322]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/pull/6194/files#diff-be4c249245e3745ed5ae394ab2256b76bff507a7eca1aeebdc39b11097c67a8fL321-L322) > >```diff >- if fallbacks := app.config["SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS"]: >- keys.extend(fallbacks) >``` >
>
>Evidence >
> >
>The changed serializer receives only the current key, while open_session treats any cookie that
>cannot be verified with it as an empty session. ItsDangerous explicitly supports rotation through an
>oldest-to-newest key list, verifies against every listed key, and signs with the newest final key.
>
> > [src/flask/sessions.py[315-326]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/2ebd3a2c43ab0922504689ce7e3eb77877b2ba54/src/flask/sessions.py/#L315-L326) > [src/flask/sessions.py[328-340]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/2ebd3a2c43ab0922504689ce7e3eb77877b2ba54/src/flask/sessions.py/#L328-L340) > [src/flask/sessions.py[374-379]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/2ebd3a2c43ab0922504689ce7e3eb77877b2ba54/src/flask/sessions.py/#L374-L379) > 🌐 [ItsDangerous accepts a list of keys for rotation, verifies against the listed keys, and uses the newest final key for signing.](https://itsdangerous.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/signer/) >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >Restore `SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS` support so sessions signed with retained old keys remain valid during secret-key rotation. > >## Issue Context >ItsDangerous expects keys from oldest to newest and uses the final key for new signatures. Build the serializer key list from configured fallback keys followed by the current `app.secret_key`; do not restore the removed current-key-first ordering, which could sign new cookies with an old fallback key. Retain the default configuration entry and add coverage proving old cookies verify while new cookies use the current key. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/flask/app.py[177-206] >- src/flask/sessions.py[315-340] >- src/flask/sessions.py[374-379] >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >

Review mode: ⚖️ Balanced: This changes session signing behavior and removes secret-key fallback configuration, creating security-sensitive compatibility and authentication risks despite the small diff.

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
